comment: ILLUSTRATIVE DATA, not a verified PCF. Do not use for real claims. Tool status: DRAFT. Biogenic carbon is not separately modelled, so both PCF values are equal. Not modelled: Site heating (the routing data has no heating use); Making the PE bag from LDPE resin; PET film stretching and heat-setting (film making is a proxy from extrusion electricity); Coating the release liner (the liner is a proxy from paper and silicone).
